neighbours.label: Restrictive relative clauses identifying a subset of people or things
fire: Every patient I examined had a mild fever.
Most people who attended the lecture enjoyed it.
She excels in everything that she does.
One in five workers they interviewed wanted a new job.
All the books that I borrowed were damaged.
The students who passed the exam received a certificate.
There were similar structures in all organisms examined to date.
Each country that held an election reported the results.
quiet: I examined the patient and found a mild fever.
Most people attended the lecture and enjoyed it.
They interviewed five workers about their jobs.
I borrowed all the damaged books.
The students passed the exam and received a certificate.
Researchers examined the structures in several organisms.
Each country held an election and reported the results.
